why.title: Why Madrasatul Quran?
why.quote: “With so many good Islamic schools, why did we think of Madrasatul Quran? A big reason: we could not find a Bangla-medium school that stressed Arabic and Islamic studies the way we wanted, alongside general education.”

reasons.title: An ideal integration
reasons.text: Arabic and Islamic studies combined with general education.
reasons.alt: New Arabic and general textbooks stacked on one table

reasons.title: Every door open

reasons.title: Quran translation

reasons.title: Ethics and adab
reasons.text: The highest priority on Islamic ethics and manners.
reasons.alt: Teachers at a staff meeting, one speaking at the microphone

reasons.title: Islamic history
reasons.text: Emphasis on the history of Islam and the Seerah.

founder.title: From the founder
founder.quote: “Seeking knowledge is not optional. For success in this world and the Hereafter we must learn the Quran, Hadith and Islamic Shari’ah, and the knowledge of modern civilisation too.”
founder.aim: The main aim of this school is to give students the right knowledge of the Quran and Sunnah together with a modern education, so that each of our children grows up to be an exemplary person.
founder.name: S M Nahid Hasan
founder.role: Founding Chairman and Principal. Civil engineer, BUET. Chairman, Al Quraner Vasha Institute. Author of the Bidayatul Arabiya series, used in the syllabus of 200+ institutions.

reviews.title: What guardians say
reviews.note: Shared with each guardian’s permission, in their own words.

items.q: At what age can a child start?
items.a: Nursery takes children from age 5, then one year per class: KG at 6+, Class 1 at 7+. The ten-year plan above lists every class.

items.q: How long is the hifz day-care day?
items.a: From 7:00 am to 8:30 pm, meals included, under full-day supervision. It covers Classes 2 to 5.

items.q: Does general study stop during hifz?
items.a: No. Bangla, English and maths continue through hifz, and science is added in Class 5. The balance is Quran 70%, Arabic 15%, general 15%.
After Hifz runs from Class 6 to Mutawassita, with Dakhil in Classes 9 and 10. After Dakhil: Mutawassita here, or college.

items.q: Does the school run its own transport?
items.a: Yes. School vans run on the Uttara and Mirpur routes. Transport office: 01733-202368.
The full fee list is on the Admissions and fees page and in the prospectus.

meta.title: Curriculum | Madrasatul Quran
meta.description: Bangla-medium NCTB (Dakhil) curriculum with our own Islamic studies curriculum: the 50-50 model, three stages, the ten-year study plan, books by class and higher education after Dakhil. Madrasatul Quran, Uttara, Dhaka.

hero.title: Curriculum
hero.lead: Bangla-medium NCTB (Dakhil) curriculum with our own Islamic studies curriculum. Nursery to Mutawassita, in three stages.

model.title: Teaching model
points: An ideal blend of Islamic and general education, which we call the “50-50 model”.
A system in which the madrasa's curriculum, syllabus and routine give Islamic and general education equal weight.
Where most Islamic schools follow an “80-20 model”, our main aim is a strong foundation by secondary level, so a student is fully prepared to succeed at a madrasa or at college.

policy.privacyIntro: Madrasatul Quran respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use analytics tools, and how to contact us about privacy requests.
policy.dataCollectedBody: We collect information you voluntarily submit through forms (such as pre-admission inquiries), basic technical data needed to operate the website, and aggregated analytics events that do not include names, email addresses, phone numbers, or message content.
policy.analyticsToolsBody: We use Google Tag Manager to load analytics and advertising tags, including Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, and Microsoft Clarity. These tools help us understand site usage and measure campaigns. We do not send personally identifiable information in analytics payloads.
policy.childrenBody: Our website may be used by parents and guardians submitting information on behalf of students. We handle student-related form data securely and limit analytics to non-identifying events. Contact us to request access or deletion of submitted data.
policy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at mqdhakaoffice@gmail.com or through the contact page on this website.
policy.cookieIntro: This policy explains how Madrasatul Quran uses cookies and similar technologies for analytics, advertising, and site improvement.
policy.toolsBody: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, and Microsoft Clarity may set cookies or use similar storage when you consent. Configuration is managed in Google Tag Manager.
policy.retentionBody: Cookie and analytics retention periods are configured in each vendor platform and Google Tag Manager. Session attribution data is stored in your browser session only when consent allows.
policy.preferencesBody: You can reopen cookie preferences from the website footer at any time to accept or reject non-essential analytics and advertising cookies.
